text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SLO breach detected on cont-batch ingestion path in us-west-2. p95 OK, p99 elevated to ~2.8s over last 15m. Streaming stalls and tails on model-pool-2. Route affected: /v1/generate (customer-facing). Auto-mitigation triggered: shed-low-priority-packets.

ops-bot: Auto-mitigation applied: route-throttle(10%), prefetched-kv-evict enabled for pool model-pool-2. Notifying eng-oncall.

Samir: seeing a spike in p99 on the dashboard — looks correlated with high variance in batch sizes. Queues show many tiny requests interleaved with very long sequences.

Priya: confirmed. Seqlen histogram skewed: 80% < 64 tokens, 10% 64-512, 10% > 1024. Mixed-length mixing causing pack amplification + head-of-line blocking.

Jordan: @Samir @Priya are we seeing KV cache churn? Any eviction logs?

Samir: yes, KV churn for top-20 keys in pool. Logs: ```[2023-11-30T18:02:13Z] kv_cache: evict key=uid:customer-789 reason=cache_pressure ttl=0.3s```

Marta: customer impact? Which tenants hit the most?

Priya: two high-traffic customers (acme-synth, beta-search) account for 60% of the tail. Beta-search uses long conversational prompts intermittently — they cause big packs.

Mike: what does tracing show? Any single host hotspots or scheduler skew?

Samir: traces indicate scheduler linger on packer node gpui-05 and gpui-07. Batcher logs show repeated pack attempts that wait ~400-700ms before scheduling due to packed-seq mismatch.

Rebecca: are streaming stalls (IO) or compute tail?

Samir: both. Streaming latencies spike when packer tries to stream partial outputs; but main contributor is delayed scheduling (waiting for compatible seq-len combination).

Jordan: OK — mitigation options: 1) increase preemptive pack timeout to allow earlier dispatch (reduces fairness) 2) enable small-request fast-path (bypass packing for tiny requests) 3) throttle or route large seq requests to a dedicated lane (isolated pool) 4) temporary RBAC to reduce beta-search burst rate. Thoughts?

Priya: prefer (2) + (3) quick: small-request fast-path is low-risk. We have runtime flag packer.fast_path=true that routes <=64 token requests to streaming-only path.

Marta: how long to flip? Any deploy risks?

Samir: can flip runtime flag via rwctl on the control-plane in ~2 mins with no restart: ```rwctl set runtime packer.fast_path true --env us-west-2```

Mike: recommend also creating a dedicated queue for long sequences: ```rwctl create pool model-pool-2-long --node-pool gpui-long --profile high-latency``` then add a routing rule for requests with seqlen>512. That requires routing rule push — ~8-12 mins total.

Rebecca: we should also throttle beta-search for now. Can we apply a per-customer rate limit?

Priya: yes. Apply temporary quota: ```rwctl quota set customer.beta-search requests-per-min 120 --window 60s```

Jordan: I'll take packer.fast_path flip and the beta-search quota. @Samir take the pool creation and routing rule. @Marta monitor p95/p99 and customer-facing error rates; prepare customer comms if we still see impact after 15m.

Samir: starting packer.fast_path flip now.

ops-bot: Running: rwctl set runtime packer.fast_path true --env us-west-2 (invoked by Jordan).

Samir: creating long-pool and routing rule (kickoff). Command: ```rwctl create pool model-pool-2-long --node-pool gpui-long --min-replicas 2 --max-replicas 6```

Samir: pushing routing rule for seqlen>512 to model-pool-2-long. Plan: gradual ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m buckets.

Rebecca: quota set for beta-search applied. ops-bot shows 120 rpm.

ops-bot: packer.fast_path flag updated: true. Telemetry note: small-request fast-path enabled for us-west-2.

Priya: immediate effect: p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.6s in first 2 minutes. p95 stable. Nice.

Marta: update: customer error-rate (5xx) unchanged but request latency improved. Keep monitoring.

Jordan: Samir — can you enable extra logging on packer scheduling to confirm reduction in wait holds? Use the debug trace but set sampling low.

Samir: enabling debug sampling 1% for packer scheduler. ```rwctl logs set-sampling packer.scheduler 0.01 --env us-west-2```

Mike: while long-pool spins up, consider adjusting batch size cap for mixed workloads. Current max_pack_size=16 might be too high when hetero mixes; lowering to 8 reduces amplification. It's a config flip: ```rwctl set config batcher.max_pack_size 8 --env us-west-2``` — low risk, immediate.

Priya: agree. Lowering pack size reduces tail at cost of some throughput. Do it for 15m test window.

Samir: applying batcher.max_pack_size=8 now.

ops-bot: config change applied by Samir: batcher.max_pack_size=8.

Rebecca: temp metrics: p99 -> 1.2s after pack_size change + fast_path. CPU/GPU utilization up ~7% but acceptable.

Marta: good. Customer impact: acme-synth saw 40% reduction in high-latency responses; beta-search reduced bursts w/ quota. No open customer tickets yet.

Jordan: action items summary: 1) Samir — finish routing rule rollout to long-pool (10/50/100 over 10m) and verify no cold-start pressure. 2) Samir — monitor KV churn; if persists, raise kv_cache.size. 3) Jordan — hold on additional preemptive timeout increases (we avoided for now). 4) Priya — prepare an eval-run to simulate mixed seqlen pack amplification and propose permanent config. 5) Marta — draft outbound note if any customers request RCA.

Samir: routing rollout at 10% now. Next step 50% in 5m.

Priya: starting synthetic load to validate the long-pool routing — simulating 1k rps with 20% long sequences.

Marta: monitoring: p99 stable ~1.1s, queue depth normalized. Leaving fast_path and pack_size change in place for now.

Jordan: if things hold for 30m, we'll revert the temporary quota and schedule config as a flagged change in prod-config repo for review.

Samir: NOTE for postmortem: root cause = packing amplification from mixed sequence-length workload + scheduler linger on nodes with uneven KV locality. Mitigations applied: fast_path, reduced pack size, dedicated long-sequence pool, customer quota.

Marta: thanks team — handoff to eng-oncall for watch. I'll update incident page and start a short incident doc. If anyone needs ownership changes, ping here. :thumbsup:

Jordan: handing off monitoring to oncall: @OncallEng (Samir will remain on loop for routing).

ops-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" by automation (conditions cleared) at 1698724030.

Samir: leaving tracing sampling and long-pool watch for next 60m. Will post link to dashboards.

Priya: adding post-incident eval to backlog: test permutations of pack_size vs throughput with mixed seqlen distributions.

Marta: end of thread — followups in #eng-runtime-ticket-5712.
